utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Kira, I heard the repair drive’s shaping up nicely—folks have already started setting aside tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds promising, but who’s confirmed they’re actually bringing what they offered?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, Mara’s definitely bringing the socket set, and Ben said he’s got spare bike chains and a pump ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up, and I’ve been telling folks Noah’s involved.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, yeah, I’m helping out a bit, I just haven’t nailed down the details yet. If you hear the time again, remind me, would you?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing—I’ll remind you if I hear the time, and I’ve been letting people know you’re helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help Saturday morning—what repairs still need doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We still need a couple porch rails fixed and the shed roof patched. Saturday morning would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take the porch rails Saturday morning. If there’s time after that, I’ll help with the shed roof too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can ask a couple neighbors quietly and see who still needs help with repairs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a lot—if you hear who needs lumber, tarps, or basic tools, let me know and I’ll keep a running list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay—I’ll check in with a few people today and pass along anything specific they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a big help, Faye. Tell me your pickup windows and I’ll slot you in where it works best.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m tied up around 8 to 9 for drop-off and 2:30 to 3:30 for pickup, but I’m free in the middle of the day if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep the repair drive simple and organized—what’s the plan and who’s handling which jobs?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, simple is good—uh, I can handle tool check-in and maybe patch kits, and you can keep the signup sheet so I don’t lose track again.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—I’ll manage the signup sheet, and you handle tool check-in and patch kits. Let’s have folks sign up first thing so the jobs stay orderly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want to come by and maybe bring a neighbor too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe, but I’d want to know the timing, parking situation, and where people are supposed to drop things off before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally—it's this Saturday from 10 to 2, parking’s easiest along Maple, and there’ll be a clearly marked drop-off table right by the community center entrance. If that works for you, spread the word a bit—I’m trying to get a good crowd there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—are folks still collecting tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, we are—drop-offs are still open through Friday, and hand tools, extension cords, and work gloves have been especially helpful. If you want, I can text you the porch address and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I’d heard they might be wrapping up already. I can probably round up a few gloves and an extension cord once you send the address.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me which repairs still need volunteers and when they’re happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So far, we still need volunteers for the fence repair on Saturday morning and the porch repainting Sunday after lunch. I can double-check the exact times with the organizer if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please double-check the exact times for both, and let me know how many volunteers they still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can drop off a few tools for the repair drive, but I might not stay long.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That still helps a lot—I’m probably showing up a little late anyway, so I can pick things up when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll leave them by the signup table if you’re not there yet. I’m keeping things low-key, but I do want to help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and socket set to the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—bring both. Can you also show up by 9 so we can start on the loose fence panels first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I’ll be there by 9 with the drill and socket set, and we can tackle the fence panels first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive noted at the community garage on Maple, and I can head over once Bo confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Maple garage works—let’s call it 10 in the morning. I’ll swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’m marking the repair drive for 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple. If anything shifts, let me know so I can update it.
